name: @arena/escalation-validation
description: Arena escalation validation/adjudication domain core (Work Order C009; issue #116; spec/expert-escalation-api.md ES1.0 VALIDATING -> ACCEPTED | REVISION_REQUIRED | REJECTED lifecycle + spec/evaluation.md EV1.0). Deterministic typed versioned validation-plan derivation from an escalation request's DECLARED validation condition (evaluator kind + criteria + threshold + output schema + verifier method + required evidence + pass/fail/unknown semantics, with typed closed plan-derivable / under-specified-with-reasons outcomes, never a bare boolean), the adjudication engine that judges a C007 SUBMITTED payload through EXPLICITLY DISTINCT evaluation (judgment against criteria) and verification (evidence supports claims) stages (architecture-lock rule 7) into ACCEPTED / REVISION_REQUIRED / REJECTED / NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE verdicts with machine-readable reasons and stage outcome refs, the bounded versioned revision loop (typed revision requests, resubmission deadlines, attempt numbers, exhausted attempts -> REJECTED), typed expert-replacement triggers that return the escalation to MATCHING through the C001 explicit replacement state, and validator selection over C005 dimensional evidence with conflict-of-interest exclusion as a tested filter (performance evidence is INPUT to selection, never authorization — lock rule 35).
